project_description: Introduce one protocol-neutral A-leg conversation-projection capability for proxy-owned content with asymmetric visibility: (1) client-visible/backend-hidden complete messages that remain in A-leg history but are deterministically removed from every B-leg, and (2) backend-visible/client-hidden persistent steering overlays that the proxy stores and deterministically reinjects on every later B-leg at a stable placement anchor. Use authoritative A-leg continuity, versioned semantic identities, bounded Memory/Bun persistence, early projection before backend-oriented transforms/routing/context/billing, a final projection guard before PTB/backend Open, a generic two-phase local-turn seam, and a trusted steering writer. Persistent steering must be cache-friendly: unchanged overlay revisions and append-only client history preserve an append-only/exact-prefix model-visible sequence; activation/update/deactivation is an explicit cache discontinuity, and anchor loss never causes tail-following relocation. Do not implement interactive commands, command handlers, quota-notification policy, verifier policy, or any concrete producer.
